description: HYD-P4DT Dataset: A Physics-Informed Dataset for Digital Twin Modeling of Hyderabad Households is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Aryaman Gajrani, Laksh Jain. "A physics-informed digital twin is a virtual representation of a physical system in which data generation is constrained by underlying electrical laws, not purely statistical patterns. In household energy systems, this allows realistic simulation of how appliances respond to variations in grid conditions such as voltage fluctuations. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
